title: SEMH Teaching Assistant
summary: Work one-to-one with pupils aged 11 to 16 at a brand-new, purpose-built SEMH school. Strong chance of a permanent post.
body:
## The position

Are you passionate about making a meaningful difference to young people who need it most? A brand-new, rapidly growing SEMH (social, emotional and mental health) school in Thurrock is seeking a dedicated, resilient teaching assistant.

It's a long-term booking with a strong possibility of becoming permanent for the right candidate.

## About the school

- A brand-new, purpose-built environment designed around SEMH needs.
- Small class sizes for greater impact and meaningful connections.
- Ongoing professional development and an inclusive, committed team.
- Genuine opportunities for progression, including a permanent contract.

## The role

- Work one-to-one with pupils aged 11 to 16 who may have had challenging starts in life.
- Support students with social, emotional and behavioural needs in small, nurturing classes.
- Help create a safe, supportive environment where pupils re-engage with learning and build confidence.
- Work closely with teachers, support staff and pastoral teams so each student gets personalised support.

## What you'll need

- Experience supporting children or young people with SEMH or behavioural needs (school, alternative provision, youth work or similar).
- A calm, resilient and empathetic nature, with a strong commitment to helping students thrive.
- The ability to build positive relationships and provide consistent support.
- Readiness to be part of a growing school community and help shape its future.
